command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP: create directory ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/drop
echo "=== STEP: set ownership root:root ==="
sudo -n chown root:root /srv/drop
echo "=== STEP: set mode 1777 (rwxrwxrwt) ==="
sudo -n chmod 1777 /srv/drop
echo "=== VERIFY: stat ==="
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /srv/drop
echo "=== VERIFY: ls -ld ==="
ls -ld /srv/drop
echo "=== TEST: two different users can create files, cannot delete each other's ==="
sudo -n useradd -m dropuser1 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n useradd -m dropuser2 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n -u dropuser1 touch /srv/drop/user1file.txt
sudo -n -u dropuser2 touch /srv/drop/user2file.txt
ls -l /srv/drop
echo "--- dropuser2 attempts to delete dropuser1's file (should fail) ---"
if sudo -n -u dropuser2 rm -f /srv/drop/user1file.txt 2>/tmp/rm_err.txt; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: delete succeeded"
else
  echo "EXPECTED: delete denied"
  cat /tmp/rm_err.txt
fi
echo "--- dropuser1 can still delete own file (cleanup) ---"
sudo -n -u dropuser1 rm -f /srv/drop/user1file.txt
sudo -n -u dropuser2 rm -f /srv/drop/user2file.txt
echo "=== FINAL STATE ==="
ls -ld /srv/drop
ls -la /srv/drop
